KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.error: Hears or says /th/ for /dh/, so dhamini (to sponsor or guarantee) becomes thamini (to value).

example.question: Mwalimu anasema: "dhamini". Umesikia neno lipi?

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.cause: Many Kenyan speakers say z for dh (zahabu) and s for th (sumuni) because their first languages lack these Arabic-origin sounds; the child then cannot tell dh from th either.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema: "dhamini". Umesikia neno lipi?" with "thamini" among the options.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.help: Say the pair slowly with a hand on the throat (or watching the lips); the child says which word was heard before writing.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "dhamini" ina sauti /dh/. "thamini" ni neno lingine lenye maana nyingine.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.error: Writes the word with the letter of the other sound (thibiti where dhibiti is meant).

example.question: Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to control".

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.reveals: The question "Jaza pengo: ___ maana yake ni "to control"." with "thibiti" among the options.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.help: Pair each spelling with its meaning on a card; the child sorts the cards by meaning, then by letter.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.feedback: Neno lenye maana ya "to control" ni "dhibiti". "thibiti" lina maana ya "to prove".
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.error: Thinks the two words are one word said in two ways, with one meaning.

example.question: "dhibiti" na "thibiti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.cause: The child has heard both said by different people for the same thing and takes the difference for an accent.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.reveals: The question ""dhibiti" na "thibiti" ni maneno yenye maana moja?" with "ndiyo" among the options.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.help: Use both words in two sentences that cannot swap: the child says which sentence breaks.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.feedback: Hapana. "dhibiti" ni to control, na "thibiti" ni to prove.
KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G7.KUSIKI.T2_KUSIKILIZA_KWA_KINA.MA.error: Takes any long sentence for a kitanzandimi, though it does not repeat the target sounds.
